f-cancel:
Part 2: the cancellation policy text. Copy it 📋 Save this.

"Need to reschedule? No problem with 48 hours' notice. Cancellations within 24 hours, or a locked door when we arrive, are charged a fee."

Pick your own fee (for example, half the clean). Send it with every booking confirmation, have them reply YES before they go on your calendar, then apply it the same way every time.

Giving grace once is fine. Giving it every time teaches clients your time is free. Send this to a cleaner who needs it.

f-facebook:
How to get cleaning clients from local Facebook groups, without spamming 📲 Save this.

1. Join 3-5 groups for your town (community, neighborhood, parent groups)
2. Read the rules. Many only allow business posts on certain days
3. When someone asks for a cleaner, reply fast: one friendly line, your area, how to book
4. Once a week, post a real before & after with a short intro about you
5. Ask happy clients to tag you when someone asks for a recommendation

No fake reviews. No copy-paste spam. Follow for more ways to get booked.

#cleaningbusiness #facebookgroups #getmoreclients #smallbusinesstips
